title: Koshihikari Premium Japanese Rice 5kg
description_en: Koshihikari is the king of Japanese rice — sticky, glutinous, and aromatic. Grown in Niigata Prefecture where cold mountain spring water and rich soil produce Japan's most prized rice. The base of sushi, onigiri, and everyday Japanese cooking.
description_ja: 日本一の米どころ・新潟産コシヒカリ。冷たい山の湧き水と豊かな土壌が生む、粘り・甘み・香りすべてが最高峰のお米。寿司・おにぎり・日常の食卓に欠かせない一粒。
